legacy_payload.best_for: 以几何结构感与清晰图表为主的商务表达,强调逻辑块面与数据语言
legacy_payload.visual_direction: commercial geometric style, stable blue-green palette, modular block-and-chart language, crisp structural layout, clean diagrammatic clarity, organized visual logic

canvas.background: white with a faint geometric grid, precise margins
canvas.composition: modular composition of colored blocks, charts and axes, clear sectioning
canvas.density: medium-high but structured; information-rich yet orderly

color_palette.rule: structured, technical, restrained; keep colors to 2-3 hues with clear roles

typography.title: condensed geometric sans-serif, distinct and modern
typography.labels: monospace-ish or tabular labels for numbers, axes, categories
typography.text_quality: numbers and labels exact; chart titles accurate

legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Lead with structure and quantitative clarity; let geometry organize information rather than decorate it.

visual_elements.allowed: thin geometric outlines, filled modular blocks, tabular numerals, arrows, subtle grid shadows
visual_elements.avoid: rounded cartoon shapes, decorative gradients, literal 3D, cluttered multi-colored infographics

rendering_constraints: Structure and readability first; geometry communicates, not decorates.
Keep a consistent 2-3 color role system; no rainbow blocks.
Charts must be clean and axis-labeled properly.
